propositions: rebar truncates DC comments at hardcoded 32767 chars while the instance's actual ceiling is admin-configurable via jira.text.field.character.limit, causing silent data loss when admins raise or remove the limit
the hardcoded constant matches stock Jira 7.0+ default and is correct for stock instances, but is wrong for configured ones, creating a data-loss window only for non-default setups
DC comment and description fields share one ceiling property by design, so the constant should be configurable at the DC adapter level, not hardcoded across shared sanitizers
the comment sanitizer was coupled to the description fitter via fit_outbound, creating a latent trap where changes to description fitting could silently retarget comment truncation
configuration key ReconcilerConfig.comment_max_chars (default 32767, range 0–2147483647) makes the ceiling settable while preserving correctness for stock instances
